what: A graph of hundreds of vertical lines (default 220) lined up at curve height. It rises steeply from 12→100% up to the peak position (.62) (sin^3.85), then descends loosely from 55→100% (cos^1.35). When the cursor is over the board, lines within 50 either side of the cursor stretch and shrink up to ‹cursor height − 74px›, more toward the center (cosine falloff) (.35s power2.out), and return to their own height when it leaves the board. One top line is the accent color

options.span: Number of lines reacting to the cursor left and right, default 50
options.pad: Stretches this far below the cursor (px), default 74
options.dur · ease: Follow length and curve, default .35 · power2.out

from.where: index.html .h-stat (number panel) · about.html .a-stat (big number panel) — original home-stat: height k=12·g=100·T=55, exponent 3.85·1.35, cursor radius 50 rows·pad 74·min 1, quickTo(scaleY, .35 power2.out), back to 1 on pointerleave

note: Line color assumes a dark stage and is mixed with --kf-contrast-* — on a light section, override it in css with [data-fx-part=line] changes the background
